subject: Acme procurement & security — post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Acme procurement & security — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Laura — thanks again for your time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Recap of needs:
- Use case: run chat/assistant features for customer support triage (low latency; mixed small/medium context lengths).
- Key non-negotiables: SOC 2 Type II, standard DPA, audit logging for admin actions, and exportable redirects for data retention policy.
- Procurement: Acme prefers purchase order (PO) route if possible; you mentioned potential procurement timelines of ~4–6 weeks.

Open questions / asks for your team:
1) Procurement path: PO vs card? Will billing go through centralized procurement (Mike Rogers)?
2) Marketplace: any interest in procuring via AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace for faster procurement/chargeback?
3) Security questionnaire: will you share the questionnaire or do you want us to provide a standard security pack first?
4) Timing: target go-live and legal review deadlines we should align to.

Next steps from my side:
- I attached a short DD overview that covers SOC 2, our DPA, and security controls ("Redwood_DD_overview.pdf").
- If you confirm PO path, I’ll loop in Sales Ops and Legal (Rachel) to start the paperwork and pre-populate the DPA/SOW.
- If you can share the security questionnaire, I’ll assign it to our security team (Priyom) for a turnaround estimate.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Laura: confirm procurement contact (you mentioned Mike) and PO vs card by EOD Friday 8/27.
- Laura: if possible, send the security questionnaire to marissa@redwood.com (or Mike can send).
- Marissa -> will share MAP + draft DPA with Rachel and Priyom after confirmation.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15m with Mike and procurement if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0148

[Attachment: Redwood_DD_overview.pdf (pdf)]

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Rogers <mike.rogers@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks for the clear recap, Marissa — good notes. Answers below: 

1) Procurement path: We will use a PO (centralized procurement). I'll own the internal coordination but Mike Rogers (cc'd) is the procurement contact who will issue the PO.
2) Marketplace: Not required for this purchase today — procurement prefers direct vendor contracts so they can manage terms centrally.
3) Security questionnaire: attaching our initial security questionnaire (V1). It’s mostly standard, with one section on data residency that we’ll call out once legal reviews.
4) Timing: Target commercial approval in ~4–6 weeks. We’re hoping to complete security review and legal signoff within that window.

Attachments: I’ve attached the questionnaire and I’ll flag any high-priority asks once our security team reviews.

Mike — can you confirm PO process and any PO template requirements (e.g., required clauses/PO number format)?

Laura Chen
Sr. Program Manager, Vendor Procurement | Acme Corp
laura.chen@acme.com | (212) 555-8173

[Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Mike Rogers <mike.rogers@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security — post-call recap and next steps

Perfect — thanks Laura and Mike. Appreciate the questionnaire.

Immediate plan from Redwood: 
- Priyom and team will start reviewing the questionnaire today and aim to return a completed version or comments by next Wednesday 9/1.
- Rachel will start drafting a short MAP and pre-populated DPA/SOW aligned to a PO flow.
- I’ll send a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) that includes milestones: security review, legal review, commercial approval, PO issuance, onboarding kick-off.

I’ve attached a proposed MAP template for visibility ("Mutual_Action_Plan_Proposed.xlsx"). Rachel — when you have a moment can you review the MAP and the DPA clauses we typically include for PO customers? Two specific asks from procurement: PO is mandatory; they do NOT want to purchase through a cloud marketplace.

Laura/Mike — if there are required PO clause templates or a preferred address for invoicing, please share and we’ll incorporate.

Thanks — I'll schedule a 15m sync with Mike + Rachel for next week to make sure paperwork gets started.

Best,
Marissa

[Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_Proposed.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Acme procurement & security — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks — good thread. A few notes from commercial/legal perspective: 

1) PO flow: We can support a PO-based purchase. Sales Ops will accept the PO number on the invoice. Please confirm billing address and any specific language procurement requires (e.g., insurer details, renewal auto-renew opt-outs).

2) DPA / SOC 2: We have a current SOC 2 Type II (2026 report) and a standard Redwood DPA draft. I’ll prepare the DPA and mark any optional clauses that are frequently negotiated (data retention, subprocessor list).

3) Security questionnaire: Priyom — please prioritize the Acme questionnaire. Flag anything that would need a legal conversation (e.g., substitution of liability limits, data residency). Aim for a first pass within 5 business days.

4) Marketplace: Noted — they prefer direct contract. No marketplace discounting required.

Action items for us: 
- Rachel: push draft DPA + SOW into DocuSign and share link with Marissa.
- Priyom: security Q turnaround estimate and any high-priority items for legal.
- Marissa: schedule a 15 min kickoff with Mike (procurement) for next Tue/Wed to confirm PO mechanics.

If procurement wants standard PO terms + PO number, Sales Ops can accept a signed DPA and invoice tied to the PO. Keep me posted on any unusual clauses.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Head of Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com
